text:
alex: Post-deploy check on dark-launch flag for /v3/generate (tag: canary-dark-2026-03-21). Deploy bot synthetic shows ~2.0% 5xx on the canary slice — noisy but not full outage. https://telemetry.internal/synth/5932 :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] synth-run summary: canary slice = 200 reqs, 4 x 5xx (2.0%), p95=420ms. failing hosts: host-12, host-13. logs attached to run.

maria: :eyes: is that localized to one AZ or one model variant?

deploy-bot: breakdown: eu-west: 0.3% 5xx, us-west: 0.9% 5xx, us-east (canary hosts): 2.0% 5xx. stack-trace hint -> tokenizer/mmap IO error on host-13.

sam: ok. decision matrix: our short rollback rule is p95>500ms OR 5xx>1% sustained for 5m on canary -> pin/rollback. We're above 1% now. I'd lean to pinning canary back to previous model variant (v1.4.2) for stability.

alex: I'd prefer to avoid noisy pages while we triage — propose temporary suppression of synth alerts for 30m (channel only) but keep SLO paging thresholds intact. objections? :warning:

olivia: fine by me, but add a clear release note & ticket so we don't lose context.

deploy-bot: suppression applied by alex: channel=eng-releases, duration=30m, reason="triage dark-launch canary 5xx". (alerts for SLO breaches still active).

maria: triage plan: 1) pin canary route back to v1.4.2, 2) pull /var/log/redwood/inference on host-12/13, 3) run targeted synth with small batch to reproduce, 4) if recurrence, open hotfix window.

sam: pin command if needed: `deployctl pin --route /v3/generate --env canary --version v1.4.2 --reason "fallback after dark-launch 5xx"`

alex: running pin now.

deploy-bot: deployctl job 98765: pin started -> success (18s). /v3/generate (canary) pinned -> v1.4.2.

oncall-bot: FYI pinned version reduces capacity for canary by ~5% due to variant footprint. Autoscaler may react in ~2m.

maria: pulled logs from host-13 snippet: ```ERROR tok_cache: failed to load tokenizer chunks: IOError: mmap failed: [Errno 12] Cannot allocate memory``` possible transient disk pressure or kernel limit.

sam: interesting — could be ephemeral. Let's watch. If we see >0.5% 5xx again on canary for 10m, schedule a hotfix window. I propose 03:15 UTC for a 30m hotfix slot if needed.

alex: adding to release_notes draft: "Dark-launch: canary variant rolled back to v1.4.2 due to tokenizer IO errors on 2 hosts; synth alerts suppressed for 30m during triage; follow-up hotfix window scheduled at 03:15 UTC if recurrence."

olivia: creating ticket and assigning infra: INFRA-4921 https://tracker.internal/INFRA-4921 — includes logs + synth run link.

deploy-bot: synthetic re-run (post-pin): canary = 500 reqs, 0 x 5xx, p95=380ms. all green.

maria: nice. alex — do you want to unsuppress now or let the 30m run out?

alex: unsuppress at +25m so we keep a short monitoring window. unsuppressing now.

deploy-bot: suppression removed by alex. channel alerts resumed.

sam: monitoring for 1h. if no recurrence, we'll increase dark-launch traffic to 20% in the next rollout. if it recurs, we escalate to hotfix window at 03:15 UTC.

alex: thanks all — summary pinned to release_notes and ticket INFRA-4921. closing thread after 1h monitor unless someone flags otherwise. :white_check_mark:
